judgment_calls.decision: Page 79 covers neck pain and arm or hand symptoms; each section gets its own check_for task(s) and Urgent priority rule.
Finding of upper limb (builder B): the page names no specific symptom, and pain, weakness, numbness and swelling of the upper limb, plus hand/wrist/elbow/shoulder/thumb pain, are all descendants.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Builder A's or of Pain/Muscle weakness/Numbness/Swelling of upper limb (a list the page does not give).

judgment_calls.decision: Recent neck injury AND (Plain X-ray of cervical spine abnormal OR any neurological limb symptom). 'x-ray unavailable' is not representable, so the rule fires less often than the page intends.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Neurological half only (builder A); recent neck injury alone (adds firing the page doesn't state); (no (procedure x-ray)) proxy (invented).

judgment_calls.decision: Severe applies to pain and to swelling; deformity unqualified.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Severe pain, or any swelling, or deformity.

judgment_calls.decision: One probable rule for Elbow tendinopathy (parent of both).
judgment_calls.alternatives: Two probable rules, one for lateral and one for medial epicondylitis.

judgment_calls.decision: Not encoded: both branches are management (x-ray, referral, analgesia, physiotherapy); no diagnosis named.
judgment_calls.alternatives: A possible diagnosis for serious neck pathology (no such diagnosis on the page).

judgment_calls.decision: Intermittent and Night time qualifiers on the wrist/hand pain itself (builder A), since 'worse at night' describes that pain.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Separate Night pain finding not tied to a site (builder B).

judgment_calls.decision: (Thumb pain AND pain provoked by thumb or wrist movement) OR joint catching OR locking at a finger (A's structure plus B's Joint catching).
judgment_calls.alternatives: Thumb pain alone OR catching/locking (builder B) drops 'worse with thumb/wrist movement'.

judgment_calls.decision: Pain provoked by movement at Elbow region structure (builder A), for 'elbow pain with or after elbow flexion/extension'.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Pain of elbow region alone (builder B), which drops the movement condition.

judgment_calls.decision: Stiff limbs (finding), the literal concept (builder A).
judgment_calls.alternatives: Muscle rigidity at Limb structure (builder B), a narrower clinical sign.
